claims.claim: Sharp AR-M201 All-in-One Digital Copier for sale.
claims.evidence: Witness report shows a Sharp multifunction printer/copier with the lid open and a control panel area, but the model number (AR-M201) is not clearly readable in the photos.
Photos show the unit with lid open and internal parts visible, but the report does not describe wear level, usage hours, or condition details sufficient to confirm 'fairly used'.
Witness report does not include any print/copy/fax test results or functional checks; only physical views are described.
The report does not show what 'ready to' includes (e.g., connectivity, toner/cartridge readiness, or test output).
Witness report indicates brand text visible but model/series number is not clearly readable; no confirmation of M301 from the described photos.

risks.risk: Model number mismatch (AR-M201 vs M301 vs another Sharp model), which affects parts availability and correct pricing.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model/serial label (usually on the rear/side or inside near the paper path) showing the exact model number and serial number.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the worst-case unidentified Sharp copier model with unknown parts compatibility.

risks.risk: Not actually functional (paper feed, scanning, copying, or fuser/rollers may be faulty even if the unit powers on).
risks.proof: A short video showing a full copy cycle: load paper, press copy, and show the output page clearly (including a simple test page).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working/untested until a successful copy test is shown.

risks.risk: Consumables/toner condition unknown (low/empty toner or worn imaging components).
risks.proof: Photo of the toner/cartridge status indicator (or cartridge itself) plus a copy test showing consistent output density.
risks.if_unproven: Price as needing toner/service due to unknown cartridge condition.

risks.risk: Connectivity and setup unknown (USB/Wi‑Fi/Ethernet, drivers, and whether ports work).
risks.proof: A clip showing connection to a laptop/PC and a print/copy command working (or a screen showing detected device).
risks.if_unproven: Price as limited/unknown connectivity and require setup.

risks.risk: Missing parts or paper path/rollers issues not fully visible from lid-open angles (tray rollers, sensors, covers).
risks.proof: Photos of: all paper trays (front and inside), paper feed rollers, and the rear paper path with the unit fully closed; plus a quick paper-feeding test video.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially incomplete/needs inspection for paper handling.

risks.risk: Physical damage or internal wear not captured in the described shots (cracks, bent rollers, worn belts).
risks.proof: High-resolution photos of the scanning bed glass edges, internal rollers/belts, and any visible wear points; include a close-up of the paper path.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case for internal wear/possible repairs.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the exact model/serial label (rear/side or inside) showing the model number and serial number.
Provide a short video of a successful copy test (paper loaded → copy command → output page shown).
Show toner/cartridge status (or the cartridge itself) and include a copy test demonstrating output quality.
Show connectivity working (USB/Wi‑Fi/Ethernet) with a device detection/print/copy command clip.
Send photos of all paper trays and the full paper path (including rear) with the unit closed, plus a paper-feeding test clip.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a Sharp multifunction copier, but the exact model and functional status (copy/print success) are not verifiable from the described photos. Without a working test and readable model label, pricing would be too uncertain, so proof is needed.
